title: What Guides the Agent? Adjudicating Unauthorized Behavior via Localizing Behavior-Guiding Instructions
abstract: arXiv:2608.24022v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents integrated with external resources gain complex task capabilities, yet the unified natural-language context channel makes them vulnerable to injection attacks: untrusted external data may be dynamically parsed as behavior-guiding instructions during LLM inference, thereby subverting the agent's decision. Existing defenses focus on static detection or isolation of malicious content at the input/output level, remains insufficient for detecting such dynamic inducements that arise during model reasoning. We propose Attnlocate, a runtime framework for fine-grained localization of context spans that genuinely influence tool-calling decisions, i.e., behavior-guiding instructions. Attnlocate casts this localization problem as an object detection task, aiming to detect the distinctive activation traces induced by behavior-guiding instructions within the attention matrix. translated_title: 什么在引导智能体？通过定位行为引导指令来裁决未授权行为
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24022v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：与外部资源集成的LLM智能体获得了复杂任务能力，但统一的自然语言上下文通道使其易受注入攻击：不可信的外部数据可能在LLM推理期间被动态解析为行为引导指令，从而颠覆智能体的决策。现有防御措施侧重于在输入/输出层面进行静态检测或隔离恶意内容，对于检测模型推理过程中出现的此类动态诱导仍显不足。我们提出Attnlocate，一种运行时框架，用于细粒度定位真正影响工具调用决策的上下文片段，即行为引导指令。Attnlocate将此定位问题视为目标检测任务，旨在检测注意力矩阵中由行为引导指令诱导的独特激活痕迹。具体而言，我们设计了一种多头、多层注意力聚合机制。
tldr: 提出Attnlocate运行时框架，通过将行为引导指令定位视为注意力矩阵中的目标检测任务，实现对LLM智能体中动态注入的未授权行为进行细粒度裁决。
en_tdlr: Propose Attnlocate, a runtime framework that treats localization of behavior-guiding instructions as an object detection task in attention matrices, enabling fine-grained adjudication of unauthorized behaviors in LLM agents.
